artifacts.title: Whether a church court may accept a member's resignation
artifacts.disposition: advice given — no constitutional bar to accepting resignation

matches.evidence: The CCB advised there is no constitutional bar preventing a court from accepting a member's resignation and removing that person's name from the roll.

artifacts.title: Judicial process against a member who resigns from the roll
artifacts.disposition: declined to advise; reference returned as improper

matches.evidence: The CCB declined to advise, finding the reference improper, but noted that GA Judicial Case 93-3 does not bar full formal discipline of a member who tenders a letter of resignation.

artifacts.title: Voluntary association principle applied to individual church membership

matches.evidence: The CCB affirmed that the principle of voluntary association governing churches also applies to individuals joining a local PCA congregation.

artifacts.title: Voluntary resignation from membership and application of BCO 46-5

matches.evidence: The GA clarified that BCO 46-5 had been variously interpreted regarding voluntary resignation, resolving that a simple resignation does not automatically trigger the willful-neglect excommunication process.

artifacts.title: Membership status and session authority upon dissolution of a congregation

matches.evidence: Upon dissolution of a congregation, the session terminates, membership in the visible church is dissolved for those not transferred, and Presbytery may not unilaterally assign members to other churches.

artifacts.title: Whether a resignation letter constitutes willful neglect justifying roll erasure

matches.evidence: The CCB held that 'deletion' under BCO 46-5 is equivalent to excommunication and referred the question of easier non-judicial removal to the 17th GA for potential BCO amendment.

artifacts.title: Procedure for removing members who relocate without affiliating elsewhere

matches.evidence: BCO 46-2 governs removal of members who move away and fail to affiliate within a year; BCO 46-5's formal discipline applies only to willful neglect, not mere relocation.

artifacts.title: Teaching elder voting rights and congregational approval of pastoral salary changes

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a teaching elder votes as a full session member, and that any change to pastoral salary terms requires congregational approval as part of the call.

artifacts.title: Whether deletion from the roll under BCO 46-5 constitutes excommunication

matches.evidence: The CCB answered yes — 'deletion' under BCO 46-5 is excommunication in effect, and the due-process procedures of BCO 27-5 must therefore be followed.

artifacts.title: Whether deletion from the roll under BCO 46-5 constitutes excommunication

matches.evidence: The CCB answered yes — 'deletion' under BCO 46-5 is excommunication in effect, and the due-process procedures of BCO 27-5 must therefore be followed.

artifacts.title: Meaning of willful neglect and gross crime under BCO 46-5 and 30-4

matches.evidence: BCO 46-5 requires due process under BCO 27-5 for incorrigible members, and 'gross crime or heresy' is to be understood in its biblical and moral sense as determined by the church court.

artifacts.title: Proposed membership-transfer vows misusing 'profession of faith'

matches.evidence: A Southeast Alabama overture adding transfer-of-membership procedures was in conflict because it equated 'profession of faith' with doctrinal subscription and contained internal procedural contradictions.

artifacts.title: Perfecting amendment language for removing members from the roll
artifacts.disposition: advice given — proposed amended language for BCO 38-3 forwarded

matches.evidence: The CCB drafted amended BCO 38-3 language governing roll removal when a member joins another church, with options for retaining or removing names when charges are pending.
